body: Test-fixture trap (Termal::Opus3, 2026-10-23; I lost two RED runs to it). In the Rust tests, `state.install_control_test_transport(..)` (through install_control_only_transport, src/tests/engram_host_adapter.rs:167) sets inner.test_engram_dispatch_budget = Some(DEADLOCK_GUARD). Every target captures that budget, so with a scripted clock an advance of ENGRAM_DISPATCH_BUDGET_MS never spends the dispatch deadline (`remaining_dispatch_timeout`). Meanwhile confirm_engram_admission_durable (engram_queued_admission.rs:409) uses the fixed ENGRAM_DISPATCH_BUDGET_MS, so the same advance shows up as "admission durability arrived after its operation budget" (a late-durability hold, no retry), not as dispatch_budget_exhausted. To drive dispatch_budget_exhausted, set test_engram_dispatch_budget = Some(20 s) AFTER installing the transport and advance past it, as CausalRoot::new does (src/tests/engram_root_causal_failure.rs:321, with BudgetAfterGrant advancing 21 s on the queued wake's turn_evaluate #2). Before copying a fault from a proven fixture, diff its whole setup, not only the fault.
